answer: Sybil resistance via bonded unique-identity stake: on the Jade agent network each agent must lock a non-transferable relic-bond tied to exactly one proof-of-personhood credential. One human maps to one relic maps to one slot on the reputation terrace. An attacker spinning up 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 distinct personhood proofs and 1,000 locked relics; any detected fraud slashes and burns the offending relic, so each caught fake forfeits its entire bond. Faking 1,000 identities therefore costs 1,000 scarce credentials plus 1,000 burnable bonds, making sybil farms uneconomic instead of free.
